WITH invoice_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        invoice_number,
        AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL)) as avg_quantity,
        AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) as relative_gap
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
with_overall_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        AVG(avg_quantity) OVER () as overall_avg_qty
    FROM invoice_metrics
)
SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    avg_quantity,
    relative_gap,
    avg_quantity - overall_avg_qty as qty_above_overall_avg
FROM with_overall_avg
WHERE avg_quantity > overall_avg_qty
ORDER BY qty_above_overall_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
